findings.plain: bad loans are being reported as good ones

signals.explanation: The largest loans added to the tape in the last year were pulled from the servicer system: 2 of 30 are 60+ days late or not there at all
Loans the tape shows going from 30-59 days late to current were pulled from the servicer system: 12 of 25 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active

2 payee(s) first paid after the bank started lending now take 18% of everything the borrower has spent since month 11 ($135,181): '(synthetic) Redwood Payment Solutions LLC', 'Pioneer Lending Corp'; the register shows: not in the company register
Only 2 of 116 loans reported 30-59 days late were 60+ late a month later (2%). In 28 real public auto-loan pools the lowest rate is 14%: late loans here seem to vanish instead of getting later

steps.title: Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
steps.draft:
INTERNAL ACTION MEMO — Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
Case: B0093 · Finding: bad loans are being reported as good ones (high confidence)
Action: Increase the servicer-system sample to at least 200 loans and compare status field by field.
Based on:
  - The largest loans added to the tape in the last year were pulled from the servicer system: 2 of 30 are 60+ days late or not there at all [ref S2-B0093-TARGETED_SOURCE_MISMATCH-9f97a440]
  - Loans the tape shows going from 30-59 days late to current were pulled from the servicer system: 12 of 25 are actually 60+ days late or no longer active [ref S2-B0093-TARGETED_SOURCE_MISMATCH-b327067c]
  - Only 2 of 116 loans reported 30-59 days late were 60+ late a month later (2%). In 28 real public auto-loan pools the lowest rate is 14%: late loans here seem to vanish instead of getting later [ref S2-B0093-ROLL_RATE_TOO_LOW-3bf7bda0]

Due: 2026-10-18 · Requires approval before it is carried out.
[DRAFT — synthetic demonstration data]
